name: AI avatar outreach - lip-synced name greetings (Zvid + WaveSpeed)

parameters.content:
## AI avatar outreach - the name is lip-synced, the rest is real
Record ONE video. Per prospect, a cloned voice speaks "Hi Mark! Thanks for connecting.", a lip-sync model repaints only the mouth on your 3-second intro clip, and Zvid hard-cuts it onto your unchanged body clip. You pay lip-sync prices on ~3 seconds instead of the whole video, and 95% of every video is real footage of you.

**Setup**
1. Zvid API key: app.zvid.io -> API Keys. Credential: **Header Auth**, name `x-api-key`, value the key. Attach to the 3 Zvid nodes.
2. WaveSpeed API key: wavespeed.ai (signup gives **$1 free credits, no card**). Credential: **Header Auth**, name `Authorization`, value `Bearer wsk-...`. Attach to the 4 WaveSpeed nodes.
3. `voiceId` in **Campaign Config**: clone your voice once with WaveSpeed's `minimax/voice-clone` ($0.50, ~10s sample from the SAME recording session), or use any stock minimax voice id for pipeline tests.
4. Set the 3 clip URLs in **Campaign Config** (see the recording sticky).
5. Optional Google Sheet source: headers `first_name, company` (+ empty `Status, VideoUrl, IntroSource` for write-back). Set `useTestRows: false` + `sheetUrl`/`sheetTab`.

`useTestRows: true` runs 3 demo rows with no Sheets setup: 2 lip-synced, 1 that fails name hygiene and gets the fallback intro.

### Record once - 3 clips (this is 90% of the quality)
1. **intro-master.mp4** (6-8s) - you saying any throwaway greeting ("Hi there! Thanks for connecting."). Locked camera, mouth CLOSED and a small pause at the end, no hands near your face. The lip-sync model repaints only the mouth region, so lighting, pose and framing stay real - record it longer than your longest greeting so the audio never outruns the video.
2. **body.mp4** - the rest of the pitch, SAME framing and lighting (ideally the same take, split at a natural beat). Never say the name here - use "you / your team".
3. **intro-generic.mp4** (2-4s) - a real recorded "Hey there! Thanks for connecting." Any row with an unusable name ships this instead. No prospect ever receives a butchered name.

Host all three on any public URL (your CDN, S3, or Zvid uploads - `POST /api/uploads` accepts your x-api-key).

**Why the seam is invisible:** the cloned voice speaks the WHOLE greeting sentence (never a name spliced into real audio - prosody splices are the #1 tell), the body scene punches in 4% so the cut reads as an intentional jump cut, and the optional low music bed spans both scenes to mask the TTS-to-room-tone switch. Ship 1080p - platform compression hides the rest.

### Test for ~$0, scale for ~$0.15/prospect
WaveSpeed signup = **$1 free credits, no card**:
- `minimax/voice-clone` $0.50 (once; skip it and use a stock voice id while testing)
- `minimax/speech-02-hd` TTS $0.05 / 1k chars (a greeting is ~35 chars)
- `veed/lipsync` $0.15 per 5s of audio ($0.15 minimum) = ~$0.15 per intro

That is 3-6 full end-to-end intros on the free credit. At 1,000 prospects: ~$150 of lip-sync + Zvid render credits - versus $3-6k if you lip-synced whole videos.

`lipsyncModel` accepts any WaveSpeed lip-sync model path if you want to A/B quality vs cost. Premium alternative: sync.so's API ($5/mo + ~$0.05/s, ElevenLabs TTS built into the generate call) - same two-call shape, easy swap.

### Per prospect: cloned TTS -> lip-sync -> personalized intro URL
`minimax/speech-02-hd` speaks the greeting with your `voiceId`, then `veed/lipsync` repaints the mouth on `introMasterUrl` to match. Both are async: submit -> poll `/api/v3/predictions/{id}/result` until `completed`. The guard nodes fail loudly on a `failed` status or on timeout - nothing is silently dropped. Rows that failed name hygiene bypass this lane entirely (bottom path) and use the pre-recorded generic intro. `dryRun: true` also skips this lane, so a dry run spends $0 on WaveSpeed.

### Why the Zvid payload looks like this
- **Two scenes, hard cut** - no xfade. A dissolve on a talking head screams "edit"; a hard cut reads as a normal jump cut.
- **`duration: -1` on both scenes** - the renderer probes each video and sizes the scene to it, so per-name intro lengths ("Al" vs "Alexandra") just work. No duration bookkeeping.
- **Body scene has a slow 1.05x push-in** (`zoom: { depth: 1.05 }`) - a deliberate punch-in that makes the cut look intentional, hides any micro-discontinuity, and adds subtle production motion.
- **Optional music bed** (`musicUrl`, ~8% volume) spans both scenes and masks the TTS-vs-room-tone seam - the single biggest "tell" killer. Keep the audio item to `src` + `volume`.
- **Name chip** (`{{chipLabel}}`) fades in bottom-left: free visual personalization that sells "made for you" harder than audio ever will.
Project `duration` is omitted on purpose: output length = intro + body exactly; the music is trimmed to fit.

### Validate free -> bulk render -> poll -> write back
Every row is validated by `POST /api/render/validate/api-key` first (free, quotes credits). One `POST /api/render/bulk/api-key` then fans out up to 500 jobs; the loop polls `GET /api/render/bulk/:id` every `pollSeconds` until nothing is pending. Failed jobs auto-refund their credits. Results are joined back to rows **by jobId**, then written to the sheet (`Status`, `VideoUrl`, `IntroSource`) when a sheet is the source.

HTTP 429 `hourly_limit_exceeded` on submit = your plan's hourly render cap; nothing is charged, re-run after the top of the hour.

### Prefer official Zvid nodes?
The npm package **`@zvid/n8n-nodes-zvid`** ships native nodes - **Zvid** (Create Bulk Render, Validate Project) and **Zvid Trigger** (render finished webhook).

Self-hosted: Settings -> Community nodes -> install `@zvid/n8n-nodes-zvid` (or `npm i` it into `~/.n8n/custom`). Then you can replace: *Validate row (free)* + *Submit bulk render* with the native Bulk Render operation, and the whole Wait/Get-status poll cycle with a **Zvid Trigger** node.

This workflow sticks to core `httpRequest` nodes on purpose - it imports unchanged on n8n Cloud, where community nodes need verification.

{
  "apiUrl": "https://api.zvid.io",
  "wavespeedUrl": "https://api.wavespeed.ai",
  "ttsModel": "minimax/speech-02-hd",
  "lipsyncModel": "veed/lipsync",
  "voiceId": "YOUR_VOICE_ID",
  "ttsSpeed": 1,
  "greetingTemplate": "Hi {name}! Thanks for connecting.",
  "maxGreetingChars": 90,
  "introMasterUrl": "https://YOUR-CDN/intro-master.mp4",
  "bodyVideoUrl": "https://YOUR-CDN/body.mp4",
  "fallbackIntroUrl": "https://YOUR-CDN/intro-generic.mp4",
  "videoWidth": 1920,
  "videoHeight": 1080,
  "nameChip": true,
  "brandColor": "#C6FF3D",
  "musicUrl": "",
  "musicVolume": 0.08,
  "useTestRows": true,
  "testRows": [
    { "first_name": "Amira", "company": "Arcadia Labs" },
    { "first_name": "mr. MARK", "company": "Northwind" },
    { "first_name": "J", "company": "Vandelay Industries" }
  ],
  "sheetUrl": "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/YOUR_SPREADSHEET_ID/edit",
  "sheetTab": "Sheet1",
  "rowLimit": 0,
  "dryRun": false,
  "batchName": "avatar-outreach",
  "pollSeconds": 6,
  "timeoutMinutes": 30
}
